DexKit 2.3.0
Project and corresponding source: https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit/tree/2.3.0
Native Core copyright (C) 2022 LuckyPray; see the accompanying license text.
The Java/Kotlin library and native Core are used without source modifications.
License texts are included alongside this file as dexkit-APACHE-2.0.txt and
dexkit-LGPL-3.0.txt. Native libraries remain separate shared objects.

Transitive dependencies:
- FlatBuffers Java 23.5.26: Apache-2.0, https://github.com/google/flatbuffers
- Kotlin standard library 1.5.0: Apache-2.0, https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin
- JetBrains annotations 13.0: Apache-2.0, https://github.com/JetBrains/java-annotations
- Rikka NDK cxx 1.2.0: https://github.com/RikkaW/ndk-cxx
